patch.value: Detect extension-host pm-cli version skew before a workspace reports healthy

GH-1003 proves a project can contain a pinned host @unbrained/pm-cli plus a newer nested extension copy while pm health reports ok. Add an SDK-owned dependency-resolution census and health finding that names privacy-safe package paths and versions whenever an active extension resolves a different host copy, with npm and pnpm layouts covered.

pm health reports every distinct resolvable @unbrained/pm-cli copy relevant to an installed extension; a host/extension version mismatch cannot return a clean extensions check; clean deduplicated and workspace-linked installs stay green; npm and pnpm nested layouts have temporary-project acceptance coverage; GH-1003 is linked in evidence
